stories.name: Mercy Chebet
stories.story: I completed the Nursing Assistant course at MTTI in 6 months. I now work at a private clinic in Eldoret earning between KES 25,000–40,000/month. The certificate is also recognised in Europe and the Middle East. This course opened doors I never imagined!

stories.name: Faith Wanjiru
stories.story: I joined MTTI with zero computer knowledge. 6 months later I got a job at a data entry firm in Nairobi earning KES 30,000–40,000/month. MTTI changed my life!

stories.name: Ann Achieng
stories.story: The Nursing Assistant course at MTTI gave me a TVETA-accredited certificate. I got employed within 2 months. Many of my classmates are now working in the Middle East and Europe. This course opens doors locally and internationally!

stories.name: Brian Kiprotich
stories.story: After completing my course I opened my own repair shop in Eldoret. I now earn between KES 40,000–60,000 monthly. Best investment I ever made.

stories.name: Grace Achieng
stories.story: MTTI gave me skills to run social media for 3 businesses. I work from home and earn KES 25,000–40,000 on my own terms. Thank you MTTI!
